text:
alex: heads up — traffic-monitor flagged a sudden spike from ~120 IPs hitting /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings, avg req size tiny, 4xx->200 mix. pattern looks like connection fingerprinting/probe. seeing 480k reqs over the last 6m :warning:
maria: on it. rolling a temporary per-origin rate-limit (200r/s) + stricter WAF rules for those paths. will push in 30s. notify if any devs see errors.
traffic-monitor-bot: [ALERT] ID=INC-20260320-01 severity=high rule=anomalous_path_fanout src_count=117 peak_rps=8000
sam_g: can we also block the top 25 offending ASNs at the edge? might be faster than individual IP blocks. will generate ASN list now.
alex: good call. also flagging for possible customer-facing impact — Jamie can you check support queue for 5xx/latency complaints?
jamie: looking. one customer reported timeouts from 20m ago but no data loss. prepping a short note to affected customers if we need to maintain throttles >15m.
maria: WAF rule applied: action=challenge for suspicious user agents and bot-like header fingerprints. config snippet: ```json
{"match": {"path": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"] , "ua_fingerprint": "bot-signature-v2"}, "action": "challenge", "rate_limit": 200}
```
alex: after rule push, backend 5xx dropped 70% and latency normalized. keeping monitoring on.
sam_g: ASN block list created, pushing to edge ACLs: AS13335, AS15169, AS16509 (temp). will remove if false positive. :thumbsup:
jamie: support note drafted and posted to status page draft. no major incidents reported beyond timeouts. customers on Dedicated clusters unaffected.
traffic-monitor-bot: [UPDATE] ID=INC-20260320-01 mitigated=true peak_rps_down=92% window=10m
maria: action items post-incident: 1) add custom telemetry to flag UA fingerprint variants 2) tune automatic rate-limit thresholds 3) add ASN block playbook to runbook 4) audit WAF false-positive logs tomorrow
alex: +1. also schedule a short postmortem with eng-security and edge team. prefer 1hr async writeup today.
sam_g: saved ACL changes in runbook under "edge/mitigations/2026-03-probe". will add ASN rationale.
jamie: publishing support summary now. will include duration, customer impact, and mitigations.
maria: closing ticket in 2h unless new signals. great work all.
